final: WITH race_country AS (SELECT ds.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS avg_wins FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY ds.raceId, c.country), country_avg AS (SELECT country, AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM race_country GROUP BY country), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM country_avg), above_overall AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, ca.avg_wins - oa.avg_wins AS difference FROM country_avg AS ca CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa WHERE oa.avg_wins IS NOT NULL AND ca.avg_wins > oa.avg_wins), above_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM above_overall) SELECT a.country, a.avg_wins, a.difference, a.avg_wins - b.avg_wins FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN above_avg AS b WHERE b.avg_wins IS NOT NULL AND a.avg_wins > b.avg_wins
